description: This file defines the jQuery UI Button widget (version 1.14.1), including its initialization, options, icon handling, and deprecated methods. It enhances form elements with themeable button functionality and manages external dependencies like controlgroup, checkboxradio, keycode, and widget modules.

classes.name: ui.button
classes.description: A widget that enhances form elements with themeable button features, including icon support, label management, and accessibility enhancements.

methods.name: _getCreateOptions
methods.description: Retrieves initial options for button creation, supporting input elements and default states.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Initializes the button widget, setting labels, icons, and event handlers.

methods.name: _enhance
methods.description: Adds accessibility roles and updates icons and tooltips.

methods.name: _updateTooltip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip based on label and title attributes.

methods.name: _updateIcon
methods.description: Creates or updates the icon element within the button, managing icon position and classes.

methods.name: _destroy
methods.description: Cleans up DOM modifications and attributes when the widget is destroyed.

methods.name: _attachIconSpace
methods.description: Attaches spacing element relative to icon position.

methods.name: _attachIcon
methods.description: Attaches the icon element to the button based on position.

methods.name: _setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple options at once, with logic for showLabel and icon.

methods.name: _setOption
methods.description: Sets individual options, updating DOM and internal state accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the button state, checking disabled status and updating tooltip.
